Render the SAME fitted DARK CLOTH TROUSERS and separate SILVER GREAVES/BOOTS as this Rune Sentinel outfit. Near trouser leg modeled in mid/dark gray facing planes; far leg darker but clearly defined. Boots have distinct cuff/ankle/knee joints. Same paired boot height/material in all native poses. Native32px pixel craft, connected light edges, no smooth blur, scratches or noise.
